PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Maintenance (Weeks 1-12)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and functional capacity during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower + Core (Pregnancy-safe)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body & Stability":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          deadlift 3x5..6 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
